authority_source: Ameer explicitly directed the Instella track to pursue the approach aggressively after the corrected frozen replication.

promotion_basis.interpretation: Frozen Think did not use action-binding evidence reliably and showed strong direction bias. This request authorizes a bounded diagnostic adaptation to test learnability, not promotion of the frozen model.

stop_condition: Stop after held-out pre/post causal evaluation and publish the adapter only if the trainable-parameter boundary and result receipts are valid.
